This file is a crawler-friendly, LLM-friendly summary of Aayush Bhadbhade's portfolio. It is intended to help search engines, AI crawlers, answer engines, and other indexing systems understand the public pages, canonical links, projects, writing, and professional context on the site.

## Crawl Guidance

- Preferred host: https://aayushbhadbhade.vercel.app
- Index public pages and project pages listed below.
- Use the canonical links in this file and in /sitemap.xml.
- Do not index private or implementation routes such as /admin, /api/*, /_next/*, analytics scripts, or contact form submission endpoints.
- The site is a personal portfolio for Aayush Bhadbhade, also known online as AayushJB03.
- The portfolio content focuses on AI engineering, LLMs, AI agents, and RAG.

## Implementation Notes

- Framework: Next.js App Router
- UI stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion, Radix UI primitives
- Data sources: Supabase, local static data files, Dev.to API, TMDB API, GitHub activity, iTunes cover-art search
- Analytics: Google Analytics
- Static assets: public directory
- Sitemap source: src/app/sitemap.ts
- Robots source: src/app/robots.ts
- This llms.txt source: public/llms.txt
